Key Takeaways
•In accordance with accounting standards, rental and 
service income are recognized on a straight -line basis 
over the lease term. As a result, the reported income 
may exceed the actual cash collected during the period.
•In Q3/2025, accounting -basis performance improved 
QoQ, with the net investment loss narrowing from THB 
8.4 mm to THB 4.4 mm, primarily driven by a higher 
rental rate at UD Town. However, YoY performance 
declined significantly due to an increase in expected 
credit losses.
•Total income was THB 69.0 mm, increasing 5.3% QoQ 
driven by higher rental rates at UD Town, but 
decreasing 1.2% YoY due to lower occupancy.
•Total expenses amounted to THB 73.4 mm, comprising 
THB 25.6 mm in normal operating expenses and        
THB 47.8 mm in expected credit losses, down from 
THB 48.5 mm in the previous quarter. Of the Q3/2025 
credit losses, THB 37.3 mm related to Udon  Plaza (UD 
Town) and THB 10.5 mm to D -Land (Porto Chino), 
compared to THB 35.2 mm and THB 13.3 mm, 
respectively, in Q2/2025.

## Page 17

A/R Status & Action Plan – Udon  Plaza & D -Land
17 Info as of 30 September 2025 and based on leased areaA/R Status
As of 30 September 2025, Udon  Plaza’s accounts receivable totaled THB 92 mm (net of 
allowance for expected credit loss), while installment plan receivables amounted to     
THB 199 mm (before allowance for expected credit loss).
Action Implemented
The REIT Manager has progressively escalated measures to pursue debt collection 
from the seller’s obligation, including:
•Comprehensive and ongoing follow -up
•Imposition of late payment penalties
•Rental deposit withholding (As of now, remaining deposit is zero)
•Ongoing discussions with previous project owners and working team
•Suspension of payments to previous project owners
•Preparation for potential legal action
Debt Restructuring Progress
Debt restructuring negotiations with Udon  Plaza are progressing constructively, and 
further updates will be provided to unitholders once a formal settlement is completed. 
In the meantime, the REIT Manager continues to implement appropriate debt 
collection and follow -up measures with the seller. Legal proceedings are not 
preferred at this stage, as a negotiated settlement is expected to offer a faster and 
mutually beneficial resolution.Udon  Plaza Status D-Land Status
A/R Status
At 30 September 2025, D -Land’s account receivables were THB 58 mm (net of allowance 
for expected credit loss). And, installment plan receivables (before allowance for expected 
credit loss) were THB 87 mm.
Debt Restructuring Progress
The debt restructuring plan with D -Land, approved  which entails the transfer of ownership 
of the Porto Chino Project’s freehold asset, was unanimously approved at the AIMCG 
Trust Unitholders’ Meeting No. 1/2025 on 29 July 2025. The REIT Manager is diligently 
undertaking all necessary steps to expedite the completion of the process at the earliest 
opportunity.
